name: v10-r3-contrast
note: V10 R3, hypothesis C: contrastive distinctions. C2's errors on its own programs are part swaps (the right structure with one part of another combination). R1's recipe with one change: every example carries a minimal-pair sibling as its contrast (same domain and parameters, exactly one part different: max/min, first/last, odd/even digits, ...; ycode.lm.compositions2.minimal_pair_examples), and the answer tokens that differ from the sibling's code weigh 20 (V7's pair mechanism). Same programs, same 2 examples per program, same data seed, steps, lr, replay and start (C2).
decision: PLAN.md: selection on dev, unseen-v1, combined /97 and family_new; second seed if combined >= 32 and no failure category loses >= 3 of round 54's items. The benchmark, neighbours, held-out families, reproduction and held-out combinations are reported.
